messages:
lee: FYI Sentry flagged a message in staging that contains a full KMS resource path + truncated ciphertext. not raw secret but we should treat it as sensitive.

sara: paste the snippet and which service emitted it?

lee: heres the line (redacted):
```
WARN backup: unwrap failed for projects/project-red/locations/global/keyRings/kor/cryptoKeys/transit-main: ciphertext=Ab3d...7xY
```

mike: looks like the backup worker logged the KMS key name when decrypt failed. partner webhook touched staging earlier too. tagging @oncall and @devops-bot to capture logs.
\
devops-bot: Creating log export snapshot for project-red staging: job id export-3287654321.

oncall: Ack. will snapshot 48h of Cloud Audit logs (KMS, IAM, GCS) and copy to gs://sec-archive/inc-3287654321/ .

sara: Immediate plan: 1) prevent further exposure (remove decrypt role from backup SA in staging), 2) preserve audit trail, 3) rotate the KMS key and rewrap any affected artifacts, 4) scrub logs & patch job to stop printing KMS resource names.

mike: running terraform plan in staging sandbox then will apply the RBAC removal. command well run:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-red \\
  --member=serviceAccount:backup-worker@project-red.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
Will also search for other SAs with that role.

lee: partner confirms they only got job status callbacks; no blob downloads on their side.

vault-bot: Received transit rotation request for projects/project-red/locations/global/keyRings/kor/cryptoKeys/transit-main. Rotation queued. audit_ref: rot-3287.

mike: applied RBAC removal on staging. terraform diff: -1 binding.

lee: thanks. on the backup bucket I found ~9 objects whose metadata header references the old KMS version. listing: gs://backups/staging/2026-03-22/ (details in the incident ticket).

sara: open incident INC-2026-0318-02 (sev3). attach timeline and the audit export once available.

devops-bot: Audit export completed -> gs://sec-archive/inc-3287654321/audit-export.tar.gz

vault-bot: Rotation completed. New primary version: 4. Audit log path: audit/inc-3287654321/rotation.log

mike: propose controlled rewrap script for owners to run:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
NEW_KEY=projects/project-red/locations/global/keyRings/kor/cryptoKeys/transit-main/cryptoKeyVersions/4
for obj in $(gsutil ls gs://backups/staging/2026-03-22/*); do
  python tools/rewrap.py --obj "$obj" --new-key "$NEW_KEY"
done
```
Owners will have 72 hours to rewrap. After that well revoke legacy decrypt permissions and rotate again.

lee: please also add a config change to the backup job to redact KMS paths from logs. example change: redact_kms=True and log kbuf_id instead of resource name.

mike: opened PR to strip resource names from logs and added a unit test. linking in the ticket.

sara: add short-lived alert that watches for regex patterns like 'projects/.*/keyRings/.*/cryptoKeys/.+' in logs and fire a paging alert for 24h.

oncall: Alert rule created and enabled for 24h window.

devops-bot: Created task: SEC-LOG-REDACT-3287 to remove KMS paths from current indexed logs (retrospective scrub) where possible.

lee: owners notified and given rewrap instructions. partner confirms no exfil.

alice (via DM to sara): recommend adding a runbook entry for "KMS resource path logged" that covers RBAC lockdown, audit export, transit rekey, rewrap window, log-scrub steps, and comms template.

sara: good call. I'll draft runbook addendum and schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow 10:00.

mike: after owners complete rewrap we'll rotate key one more time and then restore minimum-required roles.

sara: summary: detection -> RBAC revoke -> audit snapshot -> KMS rotation -> owner rewrap -> logging patch & alerting -> postmortem. INC-2026-0318-02 tracks follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
